g.text: SCR09 — Protected owner approval
SCR09.S0 · Exact local challenge: quiesced and unexpired
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled
Protected local owner surface · input and capture paused · no remote approve/navigation
Exact command hash/scope/revisions,nonce,original deadline and queue position
Current challenge ID; FIFO queue excluding expired entries
Principal/operation/hash/revisions/phase,queued count; secrets redacted
SCR09.C01 · Authenticate and approve
Enabled subject to exact local/backend authority gates
Exact command hash/scope/revisions,nonce,original deadline and queue position
Invoke fresh platform strong biometric/device credential prompt after input/capture quiescence
Effect: No remote input/capture; one immutable command waits for platform proof.
Recovery: Authenticate once or Deny/Back; queue is FIFO by issued time excluding expired requests.
No drawer or destination route on protected SCR09; Back denies current challenge.
Design only · local control/state contract; no Android implementation or authority granted
